info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Transfers API

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: profileId
params.description: Filter by the transfer profile. Leave out to fetch all transfer transactions.

params.name: instrumentId
params.description: Filter by the source instrument id.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by the transfer transaction state. Leave out to fetch all states.

params.name: createdFrom
params.description: Filter for transfer transactions created after `createdFrom` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all transfers.

params.name: createdTo
params.description: Filter for transfer transactions created before `createdTo` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all transfers.

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by the transfer tag. The exact tag must be provided, as wildcards are not supported. Leave out to fetch all entries.

items.docs: Retrieves all the transfer transactions performed by the logged-in identity.

Transfers funds between managed accounts and managed cards belonging to the same corporate or consumer identity.

The Transfer Profile (configured in the Multi Portal) specified determines the behaviour and restrictions of the transaction (for example, fees).

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Transfer transaction.

items.docs: Retrieve the transfer transaction identified by the `id` path parameter.
Cancels transfers that are scheduled to be executed in the future.
